tools.name: search_hts
tools.description: Use this when the user describes a product and wants its US HTS code, tariff classification or import duty ("HTS code for…", "tariff on … from China", "import duty for …"). Searches the official US Harmonized Tariff Schedule by keywords and returns the best matching codes with rates and Section 301

tools.name: lookup_hts
tools.description: Use this when the user gives an HTS / HS tariff code (4, 6, 8 or 10 digits, e.g. 8516.60.40 or 9503000071) and wants the US duty rate, Section 301 China tariff status, units or the official description.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_hts" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
